description: Observatory regression limits: all 15 areas use runtime architecture. Total build measured at 3.43 MB after replacing palace bakes; 4.3 MB cap prevents retired assets re-entering the release, with headroom for the optional, dynamically-imported three/webgpu chunk (~162 KB gzip) added alongside the WebGL2 fallback renderer. Source media is streamed and measured separately. Startup JS rose to ~220 KB gzip with the palace's second pass (terrain, stairs, the plaque loader and the portal's intent and shader); the cap is 230 KB. On 2026-09-17 the club and phone dock brought main to 230.3 KB, and the grove-wide controls (point, glide, frame, the plan of rooms; their bodies load on demand, their bindings and the Guide's shared move do not) added 2.6 KB more: startup is ~232.9 KB against a cap of 234 KB, and all JS ~703 KB (the lazy glide, framing, map and repository-model chunks) against 706 KB. Later on 2026-09-17 the club floor's stream added its lazy chunks (the way back from silence in the exhibit player, the sound gate, the beat follower, the door curtains): all JS ~709 KB against a cap of 712 KB; startup is unchanged. The desktop and tablet rail (one panel column for the guide, sources, who is here, the chat and frame timing, #55) adds ~1.9 KB to startup and ~1.2 KB to all JS: startup ~235.1 KB against a cap of 237 KB, all JS ~710.4 KB against 714 KB. The model exhibit kind (a glb on a plinth, 2026-09-17) leaves the startup cap alone (its hanging schema and the world's branch add ~0.2 KB: startup ~235.3 KB against 237 KB). It lazily adds ~3 KB for the model chunk (its placement, and the environment map its materials reflect, built only from classes already in the startup three chunk) and 7.2 KB for three's meshopt decoder, fetched only when a model bundle uses EXT_meshopt_compression (the bundler's answer to a refused Draco glb): all JS ~721.6 KB against a cap of 724 KB.
